---
title: "Popularity of the Name Ashlan Over Time"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the SSA baby names dataset and keep only rows for "Ashlan"
ashlan <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(name == "Ashlan")

# Identify the major peaks and set custom label offsets so boxes don't overlap
peaks <- ashlan |>
  filter(
    (sex == "F" & year %in% c(1997, 2000, 2003, 2009, 2011)) |
      (sex == "M" & year %in% c(2006, 2024))
  ) |>
  mutate(
    label_x = case_when(
      year == 1997 ~ year - 1.8,
      year == 2000 ~ year + 0.8,
      year == 2003 ~ year + 1.5,
      year == 2011 ~ year + 2.2,
      TRUE ~ year
    ),
    label_y = case_when(
      year == 1997 ~ count + 4,
      year == 2000 ~ count + 6,
      year == 2003 ~ count + 3,
      year == 2011 ~ count + 3,
      TRUE ~ count + 4
    )
  )

# Plot annual counts over time with peak labels and annotations
ashlan |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, color = sex)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  # Highlight peak points and label their exact counts
  geom_point(data = peaks, size = 3) +
  geom_label(
    data = peaks,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = paste0(year, ": ", count)),
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Annotate key historical details
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1983, y = 30,
    label = "First appears in\n1983 (5 girls)",
    hjust = 0, size = 3.2, color = "gray30"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2009, y = 75,
    label = "All-time peak:\n64 girls in 2009",
    fontface = "bold", size = 3.3, color = "gray20"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2019, y = 27,
    label = "Shifts to mostly boys\nafter 2020 (peaks at 13 in 2024)",
    hjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, color = "gray30"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 82)) +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named Ashlan in the U.S. Over Time (1983–2025)",
    subtitle = "Annual births recorded by the Social Security Administration, with exact peak counts labeled",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Social Security Administration (names with 5+ births per year)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
